comment: Room sets (roadmap F11): only in this test, Hyrule Castle and the Castle Basement take their rooms from the Example set (data/room-templates/sets/Example, written by tools/templates/make_rooms.py) before the shared templates. The 'roomset' log line counts the rooms built from the set and the 'room' lines end in set=Example; rooms the set has nothing for (sections it does not host, other classes) keep the shared templates. Contact sheets of both levels, a walk, and the main exit of a build with another seed.
